Running command: python3 << 'PYEOF'
import struct

# Verify our PoC structure
with open('/workspace/poc.zip', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

print(f"File size: {len(data)} bytes")
print(f"Hex: {data.hex()}")

# Parse
sig = data[0:4]
print(f"Signature: {sig}")
ver = struct.unpack('<H', data[4:6])[0]
flags = struct.unpack('<H', data[6:8])[0]
method = struct.unpack('<H', data[8:10])[0]
mtime = struct.unpack('<H', data[10:12])[0]
mdate = struct.unpack('<H', data[12:14])[0]
crc = struct.unpack('<I', data[14:18])[0]
csize = struct.unpack('<I', data[18:22])[0]
usize = struct.unpack('<I', data[22:26])[0]
namelen = struct.unpack('<H', data[26:28])[0]
extralen = struct.unpack('<H', data[28:30])[0]
fname = data[30:30+namelen]
extra = data[30+namelen:]

print(f"Version: {ver}")
print(f"Flags: {flags}")
print(f"Method: {method}")
print(f"CRC: {crc:#x}")
print(f"Compressed size: {csize}")
print(f"Uncompressed size: {usize}")
print(f"Name length: {namelen}")
print(f"Extra field length: {extralen}")
print(f"File name: {fname}")
print(f"Extra field data ({len(extra)} bytes): {extra.hex()}")
print(f"Short by: {extralen - len(extra)} bytes (will be uninitialized in buffer)")
PYEOF
